verdict.rationale: Foreloop demonstrates a least-privilege key concept for its feedback widget (signal:write-only key, foreloop-docs-24/6), showing the platform can issue scoped credentials. However, the agent/MCP integration docs only mention 'an API key' with no described scope restriction for agent-issued tokens (foreloop-docs-5/19), so scoped credentials specifically for agents are not evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit scope/permission model for agent API keys, docs on limiting agent key access (e.g., read-only vs. PR-open scopes), and any hands-on confirmation of least-privilege enforcement for agent tokens.
